description: LIMITATION PIN (not a merge defect). A try/catch, with A editing the try body and B an independent variable. The merge is clean and the affected points are right; emission drops the catch clause, producing `try { ... }` with no handler, which javac rejects. Same family as switch/for/do-while: reconstitution renders a control structure as `code { children }`, which cannot express a construct with two blocks. Pinned; XPASS retires it.
expect_fail: try/catch needs two blocks; emission renders one
